messages:
Rachael Gomez: All-hands in 20m (1pm PT). Agenda: product highlights; Redwood Dedicated launch details (timeline + pricing); policy update: data retention defaults & audit logging opt-in; quick incident recap (Mar 15 GPU degradation) + mitigations; open Q&A. Drop Qs below and Ill queue them. Recording/deck posted after.

Samir Patel: Can we get one slide that clearly shows Dedicated pricing tiers (commit vs burst)? Also any update on EU region capacity?

Maria Chen: +1 on the pricing slide. Also flag runtime KV cache rollback  it cut tail latency for chat; include perf numbers.

Jordan Lee: For the policy item, what is the default retention window and how do teams opt into longer retention? Need to tell a couple enterprise customers.

Anya Novik: Ops recap: we pushed a hotfix to the node allocator, added extra monitoring, and created a postmortem draft. Ill share the link after the meeting. CC: #eng-sre.

Kevin O'Connor: Ill own the Dedicated rollout doc + customer comms. Will post a draft in #eng-platform by EOD tomorrow.

deploy-bot: calendar: All-Hands starts 2026-03-23 13:00 PT  https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/1767777777

Rachael Gomez: Quick policy preview: default retention = 30 days for request logs (unless customer requests longer). Audit logging = off by default; enterprise tier can opt into continuous KMS-backed audit logs. Compliance checkbox added to onboarding flow. Ill capture action items + links in the follow-up email. :white_check_mark:
